verdict.rationale: Zapier's own documentation shows in-product AI suggestions: it uses AI to generate troubleshooting instructions for Zap errors, and Canvas automatically maps and optimizes processes. This is narrow guidance about workflow errors and process layout, not general insights drawn from the user's business data. Agents and MCP are about taking actions, not surfacing insights, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis over the user's own business data, proactive suggestions beyond error troubleshooting, depth on how Canvas optimization works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Zapier will use AI to create troubleshooting instructions for you to review.
Canvas automatically maps and optimizes your processes to help your team document, refine, and automate with ease.
